description: Test the cationic-pocket lead across charge metrics and radii, and plot the calibration
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

P = pd.read_csv("gre_pocket_netcharge.csv").set_index("protein")

# Variant in which histidine is counted as a positive residue, matching the
# descriptive percentages computed in iteration 1.
P['netH10'] = P['pos10'] + P['his10'] - P['neg10']
P['netH8']  = P['pos8']  + P['his8']  - P['neg8']
P.to_csv("gre_pocket_netcharge.csv")

ref = P.drop('YjjI_ECOLI')
print("Pocket charge variants and the substrate charge they are meant to predict\n")
print(P[['substrate','sub_charge','net8','netH8','net10','netH10','arom10']].to_string())

print("\nSpearman correlation with substrate net charge (negative rho = cationic pocket, anionic substrate):")
res=[]
for name,col in [('R/K-D/E, 8 A','net8'),('R/K-D/E, 10 A','net10'),('R/K-D/E, 12 A','net12'),
                 ('R/K/H-D/E, 8 A','netH8'),('R/K/H-D/E, 10 A','netH10')]:
    for lbl,d in [('n=10 (incl NrdD)',ref),('n=9 (PFL-like only)',ref.drop('NrdD_ECOLI'))]:
        rho,pv = stats.spearmanr(d['sub_charge'], d[col])
        res.append((name,lbl,rho,pv))
        print(f"  {name:16s} {lbl:22s} rho={rho:+.3f}  p={pv:.3f}")
print("\nSmallest p value across the 10 metric/subset combinations: "
      f"{min(r[3] for r in res):.3f}; none reaches 0.05 and no correction has been applied.")

print("\nYjjI rank on each metric (1 = most cationic of 11):")
for col in ['net8','net10','netH8','netH10']:
    r = P[col].rank(ascending=False, method='min')['YjjI_ECOLI']
    print(f"  {col:7s} YjjI={P.loc['YjjI_ECOLI',col]:+.0f}  rank {int(r)}/11  "
          f"(range {P[col].min():+.0f} to {P[col].max():+.0f}, median {P[col].median():+.1f})")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.5, 5))
d = ref
ax[0].scatter(d['sub_charge'], d['net10'], s=70, color='#2b6cb0')
for p, r in d.iterrows():
    ax[0].annotate(p.split('_')[0], (r['sub_charge'], r['net10']),
                   textcoords='offset points', xytext=(6, 4), fontsize=9)
y = P.loc['YjjI_ECOLI','net10']
ax[0].axhline(y, ls='--', color='#c53030', lw=1.2)
ax[0].annotate('YjjI pocket charge (substrate unknown)', (0.98, y), xycoords=('axes fraction','data'),
               ha='right', va='bottom', color='#c53030', fontsize=9)
rho, pv = stats.spearmanr(d['sub_charge'], d['net10'])
ax[0].set_xlabel('Substrate net charge at pH 7')
ax[0].set_ylabel('Pocket net charge (Arg+Lys minus Asp+Glu), 10 A shell')
ax[0].set_title(f'Pocket charge is a weak predictor of substrate charge\nSpearman rho={rho:+.2f}, p={pv:.2f}, n={len(d)}')
ax[0].grid(alpha=.3)

order = P['netH10'].sort_values(ascending=False)
cols = ['#c53030' if p == 'YjjI_ECOLI' else '#718096' for p in order.index]
ax[1].barh([p.split('_')[0] for p in order.index], order.values, color=cols)
ax[1].set_xlabel('Pocket net charge counting His as positive, 10 A shell')
ax[1].set_title('With His counted, YjjI is not an outlier\n(YjjI +5, DhaB1 +5, PDdh +4)')
ax[1].invert_yaxis(); ax[1].grid(alpha=.3, axis='x')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
